data.title: 芙宁娜 · 海滨漫步与甜点时光
data.description: 海滨大道的露天咖啡座上，阳伞流苏随风轻轻摇动。芙宁娜坐在白色铸铁桌旁，黑色贝雷帽压住发梢，深蓝针织开衫的袖口贴在桌边。她一手托着脸颊，另一手举起银色甜点叉，把一小块草莓千层蛋糕送到唇边，尝到奶油后满足地眯起眼睛。
data.location: 枫丹廷海滨露天咖啡座
data.action: 坐在白色铸铁桌旁，一手托腮，另一手用银叉品尝草莓千层蛋糕。
data.lighting: clear morning sunlight and sea reflections
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, hands and dessert in frame
data.promptProse: Furina lifts a forkful of strawberry layer cake to her lips at the waterfront cafe, resting her cheek in her free hand. A black beret and navy cardigan replace her stage finery for this relaxed morning break. The silver fork, small plate and white cast-iron table catch reflected light from the sea, while parasol tassels sway above her. Her eyes narrow with simple satisfaction as the cream reaches her tongue. Frame her face and both occupied hands with the sea softly behind.
